row_keys._note: Canonical column names from CCN20250428.cypher (kg_query.py export). Same shape as the WMBv1 export.

structure: Array of objects, one per node at any taxonomy level (Group 61, Subclass 36, Class 12, Neighborhood 4). Graph-oriented: each row is one node with its CL mapping, parent pointer, level (from has_labelset) and anatomy.

top_level_keys.cl: Full CL node object or null. Present on 87/113 nodes via composed_primarily_of. Carries the general CL term (e.g. GPi Shell → CL:0020004); the primate-specific PCL/CL term reached via exemplar_data_of (CL:4310096) is NOT taken here — reconciliation with hand-authored kb/graphs/BG/ nodes is a curator decision.
top_level_keys.node: The taxonomy node: {identity, labels, properties: {curie, short_form, label, rationale, rationale_dois, marker_gene_evidence, cell_ontology_term, ...}}
top_level_keys.parent_curie: Parent node CURIE e.g. BG:CS20250428_SUBCL_0014. Null for the 4 Neighborhood roots.
top_level_keys.level: labelset.short_form: Group | Subclass | Class | Neighborhood. Ranks are derived topologically (Group=0).
top_level_keys.anat: Array of {anat_id (DHBA CURIE), anat_label, cell_ratio, source (taxonomy DOI URL), evidence (EFO:0008992 = MERFISH), notes}. Group level only; 86 entries over 61 Groups; ratios only (no cell_count); sums 0.9–1.0 per Group (upstream 'Adj' fraction excluded).

common_to_all_levels.notes: Fraction of the Group's cells in the region (MERFISH, CCF-broad binning). No cell_count published.
Taxonomy release DOI (10.64898/2025.12.15.694496), set in the Cypher; KG evidence code EFO:0008992 (MERFISH) maps to the method string

group.notes: Curator rationale genes, 42/61 Groups only; not a computed marker panel. Human-style symbols (VIP), unlike mouse-style classical nodes — see case-sensitivity caveat in planning/bg_taxonomy_ingest_plan.md.

No NT property in source. Derived by _nt_from_label from label tokens (GABA, Glut, Dopa, Cholinergic→Chol, Sero, MSN→GABA) and stamped with taxonomy_meta nt_provenance. Cholinergic groups are a Chol / Chol+GABA mix — see nt_provenance.notes.

dropped_fields: wmb.properties.CCN20230722_* (colour / display-order / token / accession_* block — labelset-prefix export artefact, not WMBv1 references)
wmb.properties.adjacentCellRatio (upstream 'Adj' adjacent-tissue fraction; not a location)
wmb.properties.see_also, prefLabel, label_rdfs, sl, qsl, iri, uniqueFacets, cluster_id, synonyms, has_exact_synonym
SKOS exactMatch/broadMatch/relatedMatch edges to WMBv1 (cross-taxonomy mapping assertions, out of scope for a one-taxonomy DB; candidate oracle set for a cross-species audit)

notes.species: Single taxon NCBITaxon:9443 Primates (consensus across human, macaque, marmoset); matches the hand-authored BG stubs.
notes.nt_caveat: NT is name-derived, not assayed at cluster level; snRNA-seq gives weaker NT-marker capture than the scRNA-seq basis of WMBv1 nt_type_label. Every derived nt_type carries a qualifying PropertySource.
